LanguageData.MST.workAmountComment: Base work amount required to complete this recipe. If set to -1, the work amount is determined by the product item's work amount (WorkToMake).
LanguageData.MST.targetCountAdjustmentComment: Multiplier for batch output count per bill production.
LanguageData.MST.unfinishedThingDefComment: Unfinished thing produced when the crafting job is interrupted. WARNING: Changing this on recipes without material ingredients to a material-dependent unfinished type may cause errors.
LanguageData.MST.fixedIngredientFilterComment: Global ingredient filter that restricts which materials can be used; all ingredient slots are subject to this filter.
LanguageData.MST.defaultIngredientFilterComment: Default ingredient filter used when creating a new bill; typically copied from the fixed ingredient filter.
LanguageData.MST.mechanitorOnlyRecipeComment: Only mechanitor pawns can craft this recipe.
LanguageData.MST.isViolationComment: If enabled, performing this surgery on a non-ally pawn will harm faction relations.
LanguageData.MST.formingTicksComment: Ticks needed to form a mechanoid (used by mech gestators/autonomous workbenches); consumed once per gestation cycle.
LanguageData.MST.gestationCyclesComment: Total gestation cycles required to grow a mechanoid; each cycle consumes one forming tick duration.
LanguageData.MST.mechResurrectionComment: If enabled, this recipe allows using parts to repair and resurrect a destroyed mech.
LanguageData.MST.ticksQualityComment: Processing ticks per quality level, ordered from lowest to highest quality.
LanguageData.MST.isLightDependingProcessComment: If enabled, processing efficiency depends on current light level; must be within the specified range to work.
LanguageData.MST.temperatureRuinableComment: If enabled, temperatures outside the safe range will ruin the ingredients, causing product loss.
LanguageData.MST.maxOutputCountComment: Maximum number of output items per process cycle.
